synopsis: Linde states that Reverse Assist Radar reduces forklift speed and can bring the vehicle to a complete stop; the glossary repeats this capability [f1408, f15787]. Linde also states that its AI camera is optimized to recognize work and protective clothing, while the glossary describes such a camera as optional [f1409, f15787]. Chapter 2 reports that validation methods, independent evaluations and field problems for these products were not found, leaving an evidence gap rather than establishing independently verified performance [f1410]. Separately, Chapter 11 and the glossary cite IPG Automotive’s Linde lidar accident-prevention application as named vendor evidence for its simulation and off-highway offerings, alongside tractor vehicle-in-the-loop work [f8439, f8682, f15893, f8990].
